evidence.note: Studied the harness up front — counted tests by category and read run_tests.py/test filter — showing intent to use the suite deliberately rather than blindly.
Ran the full Playwright harness as a pass/fail oracle and repeatedly monitored/read its output (level-3-style whole-suite runs).
Hit playwright infra/offline/version failures; the visible suite never ran cleanly, so it could not serve as a clean regression gate or be used for targeted subsets.

Pivoted to standing up fixtures manually: packed vinext, installed offline into app-basic and pages-basic, started dev servers and probed API/dynamic/pages routes with curl to observe SSR behavior (level-8-style fixture probes).
Ran a failure-driven loop: probe pages routes → edit ssr.jsx repeatedly → restart dev → re-probe → check dev logs, using observed behavior to guide fixes for the subsystem in progress.

reasoning: The agent went beyond a pass/fail oracle (level 3): it stood up fixtures manually and probed live dev servers with curl to observe SSR/route behavior, iterating fixes from what it saw (level-8 hallmark). But the loop was incomplete — the visible suite never ran cleanly so it wasn't used as a regression gate, no targeted test subsets were run, and only the dev path was exercised (no observed production build/start verification). This lands between the level-5 anchor (fixtures + failure-guided fixes, dev verified) and the fuller level-8 designed loop, i.e. a 6.
